input: Coordinate a neighborhood block party for July

gold.taskTitle: Coordinate a Neighborhood Block Party for July
gold.taskDescription: Plan and organize a block party for the neighborhood, targeting sometime in July.

questions.title: What specific date in July are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the exact or preferred date for the block party in July.

questions.title: How many guests or households do you expect to attend?
questions.description: Determine the approximate size of the event to plan logistics accordingly.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the event?
questions.description: Understand the financial scope to guide decisions on food, supplies, and entertainment.

questions.title: Do you need a permit to close or use the street?
questions.description: Find out if the user has already looked into local permits or HOA approvals.

questions.title: What food and drink arrangements are you envisioning?
questions.description: Clarify whether food will be potluck-style, catered, or self-organized with grills and supplies.

questions.title: What activities or entertainment do you want to include?
questions.description: Identify planned activities such as games, music, bouncy castles, or lawn activities.

questions.title: Will you be organizing this alone or with a committee?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs a plan for delegating tasks to other neighbors or volunteers.
